te: Ready to hold the defence industry seminar on 8 September 2026, with about 150 participants
se: The meeting noted the preparations for the seminar "Upgrading Thailand's Defence Industry" on 8 September 2026 in Seminar Room B1-2, Parliament House, with about 150 representatives of government, the armed forces, academic and research institutions and the private sector, to seek ways to overcome limits such as the lack of a central mechanism, gaps in the continuity of research, and procurement regulations
it: Progress in preparing the seminar "Upgrading Thailand's Defence Industry"

te: Proposals on building frigates in Thailand received, and seminar preparations followed up
se: The meeting noted the framework of the working group on safeguarding national interests in air and space, and considered proposals referred by the committee: a proposal from the Thai Shipbuilding and Repairing Association to promote building frigates in Thailand, and a proposal from the Defence Industry Association on security budgets and the development of the shipbuilding industry. It also followed up preparations for the seminar "Upgrading Thailand's Defence Industry" on 8 September 2026
it: Working group set up to study approaches to safeguarding national interests in air and space
Proposals to promote building frigates in Thailand, and the shipbuilding industry
Progress in preparing the seminar "Upgrading Thailand's Defence Industry"

te: University study visit summarised: much research has yet to reach production
se: The meeting summarised its study visit to King Mongkut's University of Technology North Bangkok and discussed taking research such as satellites, explosive ordnance disposal robots and radar systems into real use. It found that much research stops at the prototype stage for lack of budget for standards testing and because of procurement regulations, and proposed adjusting national policy and building cooperation between the armed forces, academic institutions and Thai businesses
it: Summary of the study visit, and taking academic research further

te: Preparing a study visit on space research for security, and following up the working groups
se: The meeting prepared for its study visit to King Mongkut's University of Technology North Bangkok to hear about research and development in space technology that supports security missions and the defence industry, and followed up the progress of the working groups
it: Preparations for the study visit on space technology research and development
Progress of the working groups

te: Seminar set for 8 September 2026, and a study visit on space at a university prepared
se: The meeting prepared the seminar "Upgrading Thailand's Defence Industry" on 8 September 2026 at Parliament House, to draw up policy proposals and study approaches to a draft law promoting the defence industry. It considered the study visit to King Mongkut's University of Technology North Bangkok on 16 July 2026 and a meeting with the Minister of Defence in August
it: Preparations for the seminar "Upgrading Thailand's Defence Industry", 8 September 2026
Study visit on space technology, King Mongkut's University of Technology North Bangkok, 16 July 2026
Meeting and discussion with the Minister of Defence

te: Seminar "Upgrading Thailand's Defence Industry" prepared, and a meeting with the Minister of Defence requested
se: The meeting approved holding a 1-day public hearing seminar at Parliament House on "Upgrading Thailand's Defence Industry" to gather information from all sectors, including the needs of the armed forces, research and the problems of business operators, and proposed meeting the Minister of Defence in early August 2026
it: Holding the seminar "Upgrading Thailand's Defence Industry"
Meeting with the Minister of Defence

te: The Commander of Wing 3 gives information on counter-drone capabilities
se: The meeting invited the Commander of Wing 3, Royal Thai Air Force, to give information on capabilities and approaches for countering unmanned aircraft. Wing 3 is the first full unmanned aircraft wing, covering operations, training, testing, research and maintenance, and is a centre of cooperation against threats from drones
it: Counter-unmanned aircraft capabilities of Wing 3, Royal Thai Air Force

te: A university gives information on satellite technology, and a study visit to Wing 3, Sa Kaeo, set
se: The meeting heard representatives of King Mongkut's University of Technology North Bangkok on its capacity for research and development of satellites for security, and set its study visits as two separate day trips: Wing 3, Sa Kaeo Province, on 24 June 2026, and the Space Krenovation Park, Chon Buri Province, on a date to be set later
it: Capacity to develop satellite technology for security
Schedule of study visits to Wing 3, Sa Kaeo Province, and to Chon Buri Province

te: The armed forces give information on their satellite needs and views on the draft space affairs law
se: The meeting invited representatives of the Defence Information and Space Technology Department, the Royal Thai Armed Forces Headquarters and the three armed services to give information on their need for satellites for military operations and disaster relief, including communications, satellite imagery and space traffic monitoring. The meeting made observations, such as that the Ministry of Defence consider acquiring its own satellites to reduce delays and the risk of data leaks
it: The armed forces' need for satellites for military operations and disaster relief, and the draft Space Affairs Act

te: A central one-stop agency to help the defence industry proposed
se: The meeting analysed obstacles facing the defence industry, such as outdated laws and duplicated government procedures that affect small businesses, and proposed a national one-stop central agency, a research master plan, and cooperation between the armed forces and academic institutions. It also prepared a study visit on space technology
it: Approaches to promoting Thailand's defence industry
Preparations for the study visit on space technology

te: New chair sets a framework: reviewing laws that are obstacles, and the draft space affairs law
se: The meeting noted the policy framework of the Chair of the subcommittee, which focuses on concrete support for developing the defence industry, promptly reviewing laws that are obstacles, inviting law enforcement agencies and manufacturers for discussions, and pushing forward the draft Space Affairs Act. It also noted the progress of the working groups, such as the plan to visit Wing 3, Sa Kaeo Province
it: Policy framework of the Chair of the subcommittee
Progress of the working groups

te: The Comptroller General's Department and the Council of State give information on approaches to procuring weapons and military equipment in combat or emergency situations
se: The meeting invited representatives of the Comptroller General's Department and the Office of the Council of State to give information and legal views on approaches to procuring weapons and military equipment in combat or emergency situations, which is important to the readiness of the armed forces
it: Approaches to procuring weapons and military equipment in combat or emergency situations

te: Military agencies give views on the study results on counter-drone tactics
se: The meeting invited the Defence Industry Association, the Directorate of Joint Operations and the operations departments of the three armed services to give observations on the draft study "Tactics and Technology to Counter Counter-Drone Systems", drawing lessons from the events on the Thailand–Cambodia border and pointing to legal and procurement limits, and proposed cooperation between the armed forces, the private sector and academic institutions. The subcommittee will revise the study before submitting it to the committee
it: Draft study: tactics and technology to counter counter-drone systems

te: Agencies heard on drones in border areas
se: The meeting invited representatives of the Internal Security Operations Command, the Suranaree Task Force, the Royal Thai Air Force, the Office of the NBTC and the Civil Aviation Authority of Thailand to give information on security and safety concerning the use of drones in border areas, following public concern about unidentified drones found in Kap Choeng District, Surin Province, covering the facts, progress in addressing the matter, and preventive approaches
it: Security and safety concerning the use of drones in border areas

te: Draft report on counter-drone tactics completed, and a study visit to a satellite station in Pathum Thani prepared
se: The meeting considered the proposals of the Defence Industry Association, agreeing to coordinate with the President of the Association first. It noted the draft report "Tactics and Technology to Counter Counter-Drone Systems", on which agencies will be invited to give views before it goes to the committee, and considered the schedule of a study visit on the use of satellites for security at the Thaicom ground station, Lat Lum Kaeo District, Pathum Thani Province, on 27 March 2026
it: Recommendations of the Defence Industry Association
Draft report: tactics and technology to counter counter-drone systems
Schedule of the study visit on the use of satellites for security missions, Pathum Thani Province, 27 March 2026

te: The matter of unidentified drones on the border in Kap Choeng, Surin Province, received
se: The meeting noted a matter referred by the committee from the Senators Meet the People project, concerning unidentified drones flying along the border in Kap Choeng District, Surin Province, with a focus on coordination among security agencies, drone monitoring and counter-drone systems, and care for the effects on the public. It noted the report of proposals on approaches to procuring weapons and military equipment in combat or emergency situations, already submitted to the committee, and the progress of 3 working groups
it: Matter from the Senators Meet the People project: unidentified drones along the border, Kap Choeng District, Surin Province
Report of proposals on approaches to procuring weapons and military equipment in combat or emergency situations
Progress of the working groups on counter-drone systems, the space domain and law
